notes.title: The Daily Deck Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello Primateria Community!

We know it’s been a while, but we’re thrilled to finally bring you the next major update. After taking your feedback and doing extensive research on what to prioritize, we’ve focused on delivering the most requested features. We hope this update makes your gameplay even more enjoyable!

Here’s what’s new:

Daily Deck Feature

Introducing the Daily Deck challenge! Players can now take on a new player deck every day. Each daily deck will be selected from the decks that beat the challenge from the previous day. Beating the Daily Deck also unlocks a new mode where you can battle against random decks from other players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a6bedebd1cb7a60882c3fd3d3c817c98f64efe97.png

Zone Locking

For the daily deck feature, following your feedback on our playtests regarding first-turn kills (FTKs) and one-turn kills (OTKs) being too common, we've introduced a zone locking mechanic to balance early game advantage. Both players now start with 3 locked zones, leaving only 2 zones available. At the start of each turn (except the first turn of each player), one locked zone is unlocked. This change helps prevent early game domination while still allowing for strategic fusion plays without overwhelming first turns. It also evens the playing field for the player going first, as they will always be the first to unlock new zones, while the second player has the advantage of being the first to attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/eda2c2fba91de4ba6c4cba68d30823a578fbba7a.png

Redesigned Attack Experience

Based on your feedback, we’ve reworked the attack experience to make it smoother and more intuitive, especially for new players. You can now attack using drag-and-drop, click individually, or a mix of both. We’ve also added a new prompt asking if you want to enter the battle phase when dragging your cards to the opponent's.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/319256dafa2916a2fefdf571e624dcf64f4d48e4.png

Keyword Tool Tips

Another highly requested feature — keyword tool tips are now available when you hover over cards, displaying detailed descriptions of each keyword. If you prefer a cleaner UI, this feature can be disabled from the options menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/df146e2708e02fd6ad71e34dc5366f05884e286d.png

Artwork Contest

During the SuperXP 2024 event in Joinville, we held a special challenge where players who beat the challenge run had the opportunity to collaborate with our artist @DuckArtisan (please follow him on Instagram!) to create their own custom card artwork. With dozens of sketches made and over 400 votes cast, the top 3 designs were selected and transformed into custom artwork for cards in the game. These unique player-created artworks are now available, and we’re excited to announce that 2 more winning designs will be featured in the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/71af8a70289c22d4c4d2c9adc957fd176c79f61a.png

Steam Community Items

We’ve also added new Steam Community items to enhance your Primateria experience! You can now unlock and collect:


 6 Trading Cards
 5 Emoticons
 Badges for Level 1-5 and the Foil Badge
 3 Profile Backgrounds


Show off your progress and customize your profile with these new items while playing the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/73db45866b99fa4876a4493e265dcc153691ff91.png

Additional Updates


 A range of new micro-feedback has been added for actions like trying to attack the deck directly or playing high-level cards without fusing, helping new players understand mechanics better.
 Improved AI behavior for a more challenging experience.
 New artwork for 3 cards, additional to the 3 from our community artwork contest!
 Minor card effect changes to improve synergies and overall game balance.
 As always, we’ve fixed multiple bugs and made several performance improvements.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/23cbb4e68e6528ecfbd2c18934d0801bd417017e.png

Final Notes

We’re also very excited to share that we have some BIG news coming in the next update — though we’re not quite ready to reveal it just yet! Stay tuned for more details, and we promise this next update won’t take as long to arrive. We're already ironing things out with our publisher Surefire.Games so news should be coming soon.

Thank you so much for your continued support and patience. Don’t forget to Join Our Discord to share your feedback and connect with the Primateria community, or reach out to us via our Instagram @yfritgames or on our website at https://yfritgames.com.

We hope you enjoy this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

Thanks again for your support,  
Yfrit Team

notes.title: The Deck Editor Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello Primateria Community!

We're finally back with the exciting first major update based on your feedback and suggestions. This update introduces some significant features and enhancements to improve your gameplay experience in Primateria.

Here's what's new:

Deck Editor

 Players can now create, edit, save, and delete their own custom decks using the cards they have unlocked. These decks can be used to start endless runs and quests.
 Difficulty dynamically changes to balance runs using custom decks. Adding more cards to your deck will make the run more challenging.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/38c33525e014cf0e151e2a5c25a5c7677decba73.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a8072ff8736724c157971b164909ed9c729a8477.png

Boss Rush Quests

 We've added a new era with 4 new quests, introducing a boss rush mode where all battles are boss battles.
 The new quests feature new super-bosses at the end, providing extra challenge and requiring advanced strategies to defeat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/7c301a3bb5cf4296ffef61c12b3eb419d217d95d.png

Additional Updates

 7 new Equipment items have been added.
 7 new achievements to unlock.
 5 new cards have been added.
 Abandoning a run now grants experience similarly to losing a run.
 Some card arts have been replaced.
 Balancing changes include a rework of the "Convoy Bison" card, improved monster parties for initial floors to reduce frustration, and a rebalanced unlock progression to encourage exploration of new cards.
 We've also implemented multiple bug fixes, small changes, and optimizations to improve game performance and stability.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/78ad73f4f9b11ec292950e9462b676a847c93538.png

Your feedback is crucial to us, and we're committed to continuously improving Primateria.

Don't forget to Join Our Discord to share your feedback, opinions, criticism or if just want to chat about the game! You can also contact us in any of our social media platforms @yfritgames or contact us through our website at https://yfritgames.com. We'd love to see what you cook with the new deck editor!

We hope you enjoy the new content and changes!

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions!

Thanks for your support,
Yfrit Team.

notes.title: New Minor Update Rolled Out!
notes.notes:
Hello Primateria Community!

We wanted to first of all thank you for the feedback you provided during the playtest, your participation was very important, and we're very happy that the changes made helped improve the Primateria experience!

This minor update incorporates all the changes made for the playtest, alongside other fixes based on your feedback.

Here's the list of changes:

Quality of Life Improvements

 Card rewards are no longer mandatory when winning battles; they can be skipped.
 Divine Sacrifice and Transmutation nodes can now be skipped.
 Special unlock conditions for the legendary cards are now available in the gallery.
 Information about the current challenge is now displayed on the Battle screen.
 Difficulty is now clearly displayed on the quest selection screen and on the ending screen if you choose to keep your deck.
 Multiple bug fixes and other minor changes.
 The tutorial now explains the attack on deck mechanic.


Gameplay Changes

 Battles now give two cards as reward instead of one.
 Balanced the Battle in Waves node; it now has a battle phase, and the difficulty was adjusted.
 Balanced boss battles: improved AI and adjusted combos accordingly with difficulty.
 Balanced run difficulty: you can now only keep your deck for one era instead of all quests; the difficulty of the next quest when keeping deck was also increased.


Cards Changes

 Skin Wearer can now only target cards in the backrow. It could easily steal a powerful high level card and deal a lot of damage in a single turn, and the only way to prevent that was by removing it from the arena. Now, it can be countered by moving the high level cards to the front row and only leaving weak cards in the back.
 Ethereal Beast was removed from the enemy card pool, and is now a player-only card. If left alive, its effect of attacking mana would always do guaranteed damage to the player, without offering any kind of counter-play apart from removal.
 Convoy Bison was also removed from the enemy card pool, but for the opposite reason. Using any removal effect would easily circunvent its defensive effect and trivialize battles, making them way easier than was intended.
 Monster Grasshopper and cards with "on play: attack" effects will no longer appear during the 2nd turn onwards on the Battle in Waves node. These cards would instantly activate on summon, which would do guaranteed damage without a chance for counter-play. By restricting them to the 1st turn, when the player arena is still empty, those effects won't be able to trigger.


We have been listening to your feedback and working hard the past days to improve on the game, and will continue to do so! Our next update will be a major one, with new content and the highly requested Deck Editor feature.

Don't forget to Join Our Discord to share your feedback, opinions, criticism or if just want to chat about the game!

We greatly appreciate the support and hope you keep enjoying Primateria!

Thanks!
Yfrit Team.
